title: MCP Server Health Checker input
description: Provide the list of remote MCP endpoints (streamable HTTP) to health-check. Each server gets a JSON-RPC initialize handshake, tools/list call, latency measurement and TLS/auth/CORS analysis.

serverUrls.title: MCP server URLs
serverUrls.description: Remote MCP endpoint URLs (the URL you would paste into an MCP client), one per line. Auth-protected servers (401/403) are still scored — requiring auth counts as a pass.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many servers to check in parallel.

timeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Per-request timeout for the handshake, tools/list and CORS probes. Servers that exceed it are reported as unreachable (and not charged).

userAgent.title: User-Agent override
userAgent.description: Optional custom User-Agent header. Leave empty for the default MCPServerHealthChecker UA.
userAgent.sectionDescription: Options most runs never need to touch.
